figures.title: This paper in the 13 components, against the field
figures.subtitle: Each box: what this paper does, then common practice across all sensors and how many ledger papers share it.
figures.caption: Verdicts compare the paper's choice for each component with common practice across 8,995 ledger entries on any sensor (silent speech, brain-to-text, lip reading).

choice: A V Digits and OuluVS2 phrase recordings
M01.note: Recorded read phrases; no in-use training action.

choice: Text to CMU phonemes to 13 visemes
M02.note: Viseme targets from text only; no audio target.

choice: Joint normal and silent training with inter- and within-mode KL on viseme posteriors
M03.note: Divergence route is the earliest of 5 (pattern match) but Table 1 reports no run count, so the ahead rule is not met; target transfer 27, domain-adversarial 12 (pattern match).

choice: Normal-only row tested on silent speech
M04.field: Overt-trained decoder applied to silent speech
M04.note: WER 11.58% to 22.55% (nearly doubles); degradation already in [@petridis2018visual].

choice: Single frontal camera, Dlib lip crop, grayscale 112 x 112
Frozen pretrained 3D-conv ResNet-18, transformer viseme classifier
M06.note: Front-end weights from a large normal-speech model, kept fixed.

M07.note: Trained on normal-speech viseme predictions only; search not stated.

M08.note: Closed vocabulary; unknown words left to future work.

M11.note: Counts match the corpus split of [@petridis2018visual]; speaker disjointness not stated.

choice: VER and WER; no run count or spread for Table 1
M12.field: Error rate on a held-out set
M12.note: No seeds, intervals or named selection split for Table 1; Fig. 3 averages 5 subset runs, VER only.
